name: Molecule
definition: A chemical compound record identified by a molecule identifier (molecule_id). It is the unit that carries the binary activity label and that owns the atoms and bonds describing its structure.
scope: Molecular structure and toxicity screening analysis on the toxicology database

name: Molecule Activity Label
definition: The binary categorical label attached to a molecule in the molecule table. It takes exactly two observed symbols, '+' and '-', and is the only outcome-like attribute in the database; molecule structure tables carry no outcome column.
scope: Classification, class comparison and class-conditional aggregation over molecules

name: Atom
definition: A single atom occurrence inside a molecule. Each atom row records the owning molecule and the chemical element symbol of that atom position.
scope: Per-atom composition, element counting and connectivity analysis

name: Chemical Element
definition: The element identity of an atom, recorded as an element symbol on the atom row. The database stores element identity inline on atoms and has no separate element dimension table.
scope: Element composition, element frequency and element-presence analysis

name: Hydrogen Atom
definition: An atom whose element symbol is 'h'. Hydrogens are the single most frequent element in the database and are included in the atom table, so total atom counts always include them.
scope: Distinguishing hydrogen-inclusive counts from heavy-atom counts

name: Heavy Atom
definition: An atom whose element symbol is anything other than 'h'. Heavy atoms correspond to the non-hydrogen part of a molecule and are the usual basis for molecular skeleton and size comparison.
scope: Molecular size and skeleton analysis that excludes hydrogens

name: Chemical Bond
definition: A chemical bond between two atoms of the same molecule, identified by a bond identifier and carrying a bond-type symbol. Each bond row belongs to exactly one molecule.
scope: Bond counting, bond-order composition and bond-graph construction

name: Bond Type
definition: The bond-order symbol carried by a bond row. Observed values are '-', '=' and '#', the conventional notations for single, double and triple bond order; the symbol is stored inline on each bond row and no separate bond-type table exists.

name: Atom Connectivity
definition: The pairwise adjacency relation stating that two atoms of the same molecule are bonded. It is materialised as directed adjacency entries, each entry referencing the bond that produced it.
scope: Neighbour and adjacency analysis, bond-graph traversal and degree computation

name: Atom Degree
definition: The number of distinct atoms bonded to a given atom, obtained by counting that atom's neighbours in the connectivity relation. It is not stored in any column and must be computed.

name: Molecule Atom Count
definition: The number of atom rows belonging to a molecule, i.e. the size of the molecule expressed in atoms (hydrogens included unless explicitly excluded).
scope: Molecular size comparison within and across activity classes

name: Molecule Bond Count
definition: The number of bond rows belonging to a molecule, i.e. the number of chemical bonds in the molecule. It must be counted from the bond table, not from the doubly-stored connectivity entries.
scope: Molecular size and bond-count comparison within and across activity classes
